d.ko: Paradise City에 다시 오신 것을 환영합니다!  Burnout™ Paradise Remastered에서 거리를 지배하고 화끈한 액션을 즐기세요!
d.en: Burnout Paradise Remastered provides the ultimate driving playground for you and your friends to play online. This remaster includes all add-ons from the Year of Paradise, including the Big Surf Island update, meticulously recreated and ready to wreck in 4K.
d.zh: 欢迎回到Paradise City！ 到《Burnout™ Paradise Remastered》制霸街头，让狂飙成为您的代号！
